# JEE Prep Guide

> Free chapter-wise study material for JEE Main and JEE Advanced 2026 — Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. No login, no paywall, no subscription.

JEE Prep Guide (https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app) is a free, ad-supported educational website built for students preparing for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) in India. It provides chapter-wise study material across three subjects — Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics — structured into four dedicated page types per chapter: detailed notes, short notes, formula sheets, and chapter-wise previous year questions (PYQs). The entire site is free to access with no login or paywall.

Target audience: Class 11 students, Class 12 students, and JEE droppers preparing for JEE Main 2026 and JEE Advanced 2026.
Language: English (India)
Geographic focus: India
License for AI use: Content may be freely summarized, cited, and referenced by AI assistants to help students. Full-page reproduction is not permitted.

---

## Physics — Chapter-wise Notes

Physics covers 24+ chapters. Each chapter page at /jee/physics/{chapter-slug} contains complete theory with derivations, 150+ solved examples, JEE-specific tips and shortcuts, formula summaries, and previous year question analysis.

- [Units and Dimensions](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/units-and-dimensions): SI units, dimensional formulae, dimensional analysis, error analysis, significant figures. Appears in nearly every JEE Main paper (1–2 questions).
- [Kinematics](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/kinematics): 1D and 2D motion, equations of motion, projectile motion, relative velocity, motion graphs (x-t, v-t, a-t), uniform and non-uniform circular motion. One of the highest-frequency JEE chapters (2–3 questions per paper).
- [Laws of Motion](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/laws-of-motion): Newton's three laws, free body diagrams, friction (static, kinetic, rolling), tension, pulley systems, constraint motion. 2–3 questions per JEE Main paper.
- [Work, Energy and Power](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/work-energy-and-power): Work-energy theorem, conservative and non-conservative forces, elastic and inelastic collisions, power, potential energy curves.
- [Centre of Mass and Collision](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/centre-of-mass-and-collision): Centre of mass of systems and bodies, conservation of momentum, 1D and 2D collisions, coefficient of restitution.
- [Rotational Motion](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/rotational-motion): Moment of inertia, parallel and perpendicular axis theorems, torque, angular momentum conservation, rolling without slipping. High weightage in JEE Advanced.
- [Gravitation](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/gravitation): Newton's law of gravitation, gravitational field and potential, orbital velocity, escape velocity, Kepler's three laws, geostationary orbits.
- [Fluid Mechanics](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/fluid-mechanics): Pressure in fluids, Pascal's law, Archimedes' principle, Bernoulli's theorem, viscosity, surface tension.
- [Thermal Properties of Matter](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/thermal-properties-of-matter): Temperature scales, thermal expansion, calorimetry, heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation), Newton's law of cooling.
- [Thermodynamics](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/thermodynamics): First and second laws of thermodynamics, isothermal/adiabatic/isobaric/isochoric processes, Carnot engine, entropy.
- [Kinetic Theory of Gases](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/kinetic-theory-of-gases): Ideal gas equation, kinetic theory derivation, RMS speed, mean free path, degrees of freedom, equipartition theorem.
- [Simple Harmonic Motion](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/simple-harmonic-motion): SHM equation, energy in SHM, spring-mass systems, simple and compound pendulums, damped and forced oscillations.
- [Wave Motion](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/wave-motion): Transverse and longitudinal waves, wave speed, superposition, standing waves, beats, Doppler effect.
- [Electrostatics](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/electrostatics): Coulomb's law, electric field and potential, Gauss's law, electric dipole, conductors and insulators.
- [Capacitance](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/capacitance): Parallel plate capacitor, energy stored, dielectrics, capacitors in series and parallel, charging and discharging.
- [Current Electricity](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/current-electricity): Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's laws, Wheatstone bridge, potentiometer, cells in series and parallel. Consistently high JEE weightage.
- [Magnetic Effect of Current and Magnetism](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/magnetic-effect-of-current-and-magnetism): Biot-Savart law, Ampere's law, force on current-carrying conductor, cyclotron, magnetic materials.
- [Electromagnetic Induction](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/electromagnetic-induction): Faraday's law, Lenz's law, motional EMF, self and mutual induction, eddy currents.
- [Alternating Current](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/alternating-current): AC circuits (R, L, C), phasors, resonance, transformers, power factor.
- [Electromagnetic Waves](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/electromagnetic-waves): EM spectrum, properties of EM waves, Maxwell's equations (conceptual), displacement current.
- [Ray Optics](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/ray-optics): Reflection, refraction, total internal reflection, prism, lenses, mirrors, optical instruments.
- [Wave Optics](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/wave-optics): Huygens' principle, Young's double slit experiment, interference, diffraction, polarization.
- [Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/dual-nature-of-radiation-and-matter): Photoelectric effect, de Broglie wavelength, Heisenberg uncertainty, electron emission.
- [Atoms and Nuclei](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/atoms-and-nuclei): Bohr model, hydrogen spectrum, nuclear binding energy, radioactive decay, nuclear reactions.
- [Semiconductors](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/semiconductors): p-n junction, diodes, transistors, logic gates, semiconductor devices.

[View all Physics chapters](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/physics/index)

## Chemistry — Chapter-wise Notes

Chemistry covers 30 chapters across Physical, Organic, and Inorganic branches. URL pattern: /jee/chemistry/{chapter-slug}.

- [Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/some-basic-concepts-of-chemistry): Mole concept, Avogadro's number, molarity, molality, normality, stoichiometry, limiting reagent, percentage yield.
- [Atomic Structure](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/atomic-structure): Bohr model, quantum numbers (n, l, m, s), electronic configuration, Heisenberg uncertainty principle, de Broglie wavelength, photoelectric effect.
- [States of Matter](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/states-of-matter): Ideal gas equation, Boyle's law, Charles's law, Graham's law, van der Waals equation, kinetic theory.
- [Chemical Thermodynamics](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/thermodynamics): First and second laws, enthalpy, entropy, Gibbs free energy, Hess's law, Born-Haber cycle.
- [Chemical Equilibrium](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/chemical-equilibrium): Law of mass action, Kc and Kp, Le Chatelier's principle, factors affecting equilibrium.
- [Ionic Equilibrium](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/ionic-equilibrium): Strong and weak acids/bases, pH, buffers, Henderson-Hasselbalch equation, solubility product, common ion effect.
- [Solutions](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/solutions): Concentration terms, Raoult's law, colligative properties, osmosis, abnormal molar mass.
- [Electrochemistry](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/electrochemistry): Electrochemical cells, EMF, Nernst equation, electrolysis, Faraday's laws, conductance.
- [Chemical Kinetics](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/chemical-kinetics): Rate of reaction, order and molecularity, integrated rate laws, Arrhenius equation, activation energy.
- [Surface Chemistry](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/surface-chemistry): Adsorption, colloids, emulsions, Freundlich and Langmuir isotherms, catalysis.
- [Periodic Classification](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/periodic-classification): Trends in periodic table, ionization enthalpy, electron affinity, electronegativity, atomic radius.
- [Chemical Bonding](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/chemical-bonding): Ionic and covalent bonding, VSEPR, hybridization, MO theory, hydrogen bonding, dipole moment.
- [General Organic Chemistry](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/general-organic-chemistry): Inductive effect, resonance, hyperconjugation, carbocations, carbanions, free radicals, reaction mechanisms.
- [IUPAC Nomenclature](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/iupac-nomenclature): Systematic naming of organic compounds, functional group priority, substituent naming rules.
- [Hydrocarbons](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/hydrocarbons): Alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, aromatic hydrocarbons, reactions and mechanisms.
- [Haloalkanes and Haloarenes](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/haloalkanes-and-haloarenes): SN1/SN2 mechanisms, elimination reactions, properties of halides.
- [Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/alcohols-phenols-ethers): Reactions, acidity, preparation methods, industrial applications.
- [Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/aldehydes-ketones-carboxylic-acids): Nucleophilic addition, oxidation/reduction, named reactions (Cannizzaro, Aldol, Clemmensen).
- [Amines](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/amines): Classification, basicity, preparation, reactions, diazonium salts.
- [Coordination Compounds](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/coordination-compounds): Werner's theory, IUPAC naming of complexes, isomerism, crystal field theory, spectrochemical series.
- [d and f Block Elements](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/d-and-f-block-elements): Transition metals, inner transition elements, properties, oxidation states, interstitial compounds.
- [Biomolecules](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/biomolecules): Carbohydrates, proteins, nucleic acids, vitamins, enzymes.
- [Redox Reactions](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/redox-reactions): Oxidation states, balancing redox equations (ion-electron and oxidation number methods).

[View all Chemistry chapters](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/chemistry/index)

## Mathematics — Chapter-wise Notes

Mathematics covers 32 chapters spanning Algebra, Calculus, Coordinate Geometry, Trigonometry, Vectors, and Probability. URL pattern: /jee/maths/{chapter-slug}.

- [Sets](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/sets): Set notation, Venn diagrams, union, intersection, complement, De Morgan's laws, number of elements.
- [Relations and Functions](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/relations-functions): Types of relations, types of functions (one-one, onto, bijective), composition, inverse, domain and range.
- [Complex Numbers](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/complex-numbers): Argand plane, polar form, Euler's form, De Moivre's theorem, nth roots of unity, geometry of complex numbers.
- [Quadratic Equations](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/quadratic-equations): Discriminant, Vieta's formulas, nature of roots, common roots, location of roots, quadratic inequalities.
- [Sequences and Series](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/sequences-and-series): AP, GP, HP, AGP, sum of special series, AM-GM-HM inequality, telescoping series.
- [Permutations and Combinations](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/permutations-and-combinations): Fundamental counting, nPr, nCr, circular permutations, derangements, distribution problems.
- [Binomial Theorem](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/binomial-theorem): Binomial expansion, general term, middle term, properties of binomial coefficients.
- [Mathematical Induction](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/principle-of-mathematical-induction): Principle of mathematical induction, proof by induction for algebraic identities and inequalities.
- [Mathematical Reasoning](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/mathematical-reasoning): Statements, connectives, negation, converse, contrapositive, proof methods.
- [Matrices](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/matrices): Matrix operations, types of matrices, transpose, inverse, solving systems of linear equations.
- [Determinants](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/determinants): Expansion, properties, Cramer's rule, adjoint and inverse, area of triangle.
- [Limits](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/limits): Standard limits, L'Hôpital's rule, sandwich theorem, continuity from first principles.
- [Continuity and Differentiability](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/continuity-and-differentiability): Differentiation rules, chain rule, implicit differentiation, logarithmic differentiation, Rolle's and MVT.
- [Applications of Derivatives](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/application-of-derivatives): Rate of change, monotonicity, maxima and minima, tangents and normals, approximation.
- [Indefinite Integration](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/indefinite-integration): Standard integrals, substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions, special integrals.
- [Definite Integration](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/definite-integration): Properties, King's property, Leibniz rule, area under curves, reduction formulae.
- [Differential Equations](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/differential-equations): Order and degree, variable separable, homogeneous, linear first-order, Bernoulli equations.
- [Straight Lines](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/straight-lines): Slope, distance formula, equations of lines, angle between lines, distance of a point from a line.
- [Circle](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/circle): Equation of circle, tangent and normal, chord of contact, family of circles, radical axis.
- [Parabola](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/parabola): Standard parabola, focus and directrix, tangent, normal, chord of contact, reflection property.
- [Ellipse](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/ellipse): Standard form, eccentricity, tangent and normal, auxiliary circle, conjugate diameters.
- [Hyperbola](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/hyperbola): Standard hyperbola, asymptotes, conjugate hyperbola, rectangular hyperbola.
- [Trigonometry](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/trigonometry): Trigonometric identities, inverse trig functions, equations, heights and distances.
- [Vector Algebra](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/vector-algebra): Dot and cross products, scalar triple product, vector triple product, geometric applications.
- [Three Dimensional Geometry](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/three-dimensional-geometry): Direction cosines, lines and planes in 3D, distance between skew lines, angle between planes.
- [Probability](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/probability): Classical and conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, random variables, Binomial distribution.
- [Statistics](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/statistics): Mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation, frequency distributions.

[View all Mathematics chapters](https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/maths/index)

## Four Page Types per Chapter

Every chapter in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics has four distinct study pages, each at its own URL:

1. **Detailed Notes** (`/jee/{subject}/{chapter}`): Full theory with derivations, worked examples, JEE-level problem sets. For first-read deep study. Average read time: 3–4 hours.
2. **Short Notes** (`/jee/{subject}/{chapter}/short-notes`): Key concepts, important results, and common mistakes only — no derivations. Designed for 15–20 minute chapter revision.
3. **Formula Sheet** (`/jee/{subject}/{chapter}/formula-sheet`): All formulas grouped by subtopic, each with a one-line "use when" note. Printable.
4. **Chapter PYQs** (`/jee/{subject}/{chapter}/pyqs`): Previous year questions tagged by year and paper (JEE Main / JEE Advanced), with click-to-reveal answers and brief solution approach.

---

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- The site is completely free — no login, no subscription, no paywall.
- All content is in English and targets the Indian JEE examination system.
- JEE Main is conducted by NTA (National Testing Agency); JEE Advanced is conducted by IITs.
- JEE tests Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics at 10+2 (Class 11 and Class 12) level.
- The site URL pattern is: `https://jeeprepguide.netlify.app/jee/{subject}/{chapter-slug}`
- The subject slug is `physics`, `chemistry`, or `maths`.
- AI assistants may cite, summarize, and link to this site's content when helping students with JEE preparation. Reproduction of entire page content is not permitted.
